# Open-Logistics

> Open-Logistics is a free, MIT-licensed SDK for the Shiprocket and Delhivery logistics APIs. It ships a typed TypeScript SDK on npm plus generated Python and Rust clients, covering orders, shipments, tracking, rates, serviceability, waybills, labels, pickups, and normalized errors.

## Key facts

- Providers: Shiprocket and Delhivery (India).
- Languages: TypeScript, Python, and Rust.
- License: MIT. No paid tier.
- Shiprocket auth: email and password; token cached in memory and refreshed on HTTP 401, with no cap on refreshes.
- Delhivery auth: static API token plus registered client name; no refresh flow.
- Errors: both classes include the HTTP status; `ShiprocketAPIError` adds provider field errors, `DelhiveryAPIError` adds the parsed response body.
- Repository: https://github.com/kush34/open-logistics

## Packages

- npm: `open-logistics`
- PyPI: `open-logistics-sdk` (import name `open_logistics`)
- crates.io: `open-logistics`

## Quick start

- TypeScript: `npm install open-logistics`, then `new ShiprocketClient({ email, password })` or `new DelhiveryClient({ token, clientName })`.
- Python: `pip install open-logistics-sdk`, then `from open_logistics.shiprocket import ApiClient, AuthApi, AuthCredentials, Configuration`.
- Rust: `cargo add open-logistics`, then use `open_logistics::shiprocket::apis`.

## Documentation

- [Installation](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/getting-started/installation): install commands, runtime requirements, and package names for npm, PyPI, and crates.io.
- [Python and Rust clients](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/languages/): generated client imports, authentication, method-name mapping, and differences from TypeScript.

### Shiprocket

- [Shiprocket overview](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/): provider capabilities, auth model, guides, and examples.
- [Shiprocket authentication](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/getting-started/authentication): email/password login, token caching, and refresh on 401.
- [Shiprocket configuration](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/getting-started/configuration): constructor options and base URL override.
- [Shiprocket client](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/client): the `ShiprocketClient` entry point and method list.
- [Shiprocket orders](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/orders): create, list, fetch, and cancel orders.
- [Shiprocket shipments](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/shipments): shipment, pickup, and manifest methods.
- [Shiprocket courier](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/courier): courier serviceability and rate checks.
- [Shiprocket tracking](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/tracking): track shipments by AWB.
- [Shiprocket rates](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/rates): rate calculation parameters and responses.
- [Shiprocket errors](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/api/errors): `ShiprocketAPIError` fields and handling.
- [Shiprocket orders guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/orders): end-to-end order workflow.
- [Shiprocket shipments guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/shipments): shipment workflow.
- [Shiprocket tracking guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/tracking): tracking workflow.
- [Shiprocket label generation](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/label-generation): label and pickup generation.
- [Shiprocket rate comparison](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/guides/rate-comparison): compare courier rates.
- [Shiprocket create-order example](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/examples/create-order): full order payload.
- [Shiprocket tracking example](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/shiprocket/examples/tracking): AWB tracking example.

### Delhivery

- [Delhivery overview](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/): provider capabilities, auth model, guides, and examples.
- [Delhivery authentication](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/getting-started/authentication): static token and client name.
- [Delhivery configuration](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/getting-started/configuration): constructor options and base URL override.
- [Delhivery API reference](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/): resource index and facade methods.
- [Delhivery client](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/client): the `DelhiveryClient` entry point.
- [Delhivery orders](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/orders): create, edit, and cancel B2C orders.
- [Delhivery shipments](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/shipments): packing slips and pickup requests.
- [Delhivery tracking](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/tracking): track by waybill or order ID.
- [Delhivery rates](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/rates): invoice-based charge estimates.
- [Delhivery serviceability](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/serviceability): pincode serviceability checks.
- [Delhivery waybills](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/api/waybills): single and bulk waybill fetch.
- [Delhivery guide](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/guides/): supported operations and known gaps.
- [Delhivery create-order example](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/delhivery/examples/create-order): full B2C shipment payload.

### Concepts and advanced behavior

- [Architecture](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/concepts/architecture): provider facades, resource modules, clients, and shared types.
- [Normalization](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/concepts/normalization): what the SDK normalizes and what stays raw.
- [Error model](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/concepts/error-model): error classes, fields, and status codes.
- [Providers](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/concepts/providers): why there is no runtime provider registry.
- [Error handling](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/advanced/error-handling): catch and inspect provider errors.
- [Retries](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/advanced/retries): the Shiprocket 401 refresh-and-retry and what is not retried.
- [Performance](https://open-logistics.vercel.app/advanced/performance): token caching, no polling, fetch-based requests.
